decisions.statement: A domain name is defined on the domain page.
A page address is defined in the page address system.
A common language term is defined on a page of its own.
A foreign name is defined on a page of its own.
A word and that word's variants are one term.
Two spellings that differ only by grammar are variants.
A term is written under its plainest spelling.

definition: one word or phrase, and what that word means here
